description: This file defines the EntityTagMatcher class, which provides methods to parse, create, and compare EntityTags based on string input, including handling wildcards (*). It includes static factory methods, matching logic, and equality/hashCode overrides.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcher
classes.description: Immutable class for matching entity tags or wildcards, with methods to create matchers from strings and to check matches.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTagMatcher from a string, returning a singleton instance if the string is an asterisk.

methods.name: asterisk
methods.description: Returns the singleton EntityTagMatcher representing an asterisk (*).

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid EntityTagMatcher, either an asterisk or a valid EntityTag.

methods.name: strongMatch
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison match against an EntityTag, always true if asterisk.

methods.name: weakMatch
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison match against an EntityTag, always true if asterisk.

methods.name: isAsterisk
methods.description: Returns true if this matcher is the asterisk wildcard.
